patterns.bulk_operations: Uses transaction.atomic() to wrap bulk operations, processes list of IDs in a loop, returns JsonResponse with success/failure counts
patterns.ajax_endpoints: All AJAX endpoints use @login_required, @require_http_methods(['POST']), and return JsonResponse
patterns.url_pattern: Bulk operations use /resource/batch-action/ pattern (e.g., bins/batch-create/, bins/batch-print/)
patterns.ui_selection: Alpine.js manages selectedItems array, checkboxes on each row, toggleSelection() and toggleSelectAll() methods
patterns.status_methods: ProductionOrder has start(user) and complete(user) methods that validate status transitions and return True/False

existing_implementations.description: Bulk operations pattern exists for bin batch creation and printing with transaction.atomic(), checkbox selection UI, and detailed result reporting

discovered_details.csrf_token_handling: All AJAX requests include X-CSRFToken header
